notes: Hampton Bay 84066 solar LED path light (Home Depot item 1003 459 415). The guide gives one 1.2 V 1000 mAh AA NiMH cell as the replacement and says the light ships with it pre-installed.

gaps: The guide gives no solar panel volts, watts or size, no LED count and no lumens.
The package table lists quantity 6 for every part (cover, cell, housing, post, stake), so a box may hold six lights; only the replacement-cell line (one cell) is used for the per-light count.
The guide only warns that nearby porch or street lights can stop the light turning on automatically; it names no sensor, so no dusk sensor part is claimed.
No driver chip, inductor, charger circuit or switch is named, so none is claimed.
A Home Depot Q&A title for 84066 (not opened) gives 15 lumens and a 6-pack; neither is claimed.
Check the model number on the box before applying these specs.
method: Hampton Bay Use and Care Guide, Solar LED Path Light, Model #84066, Item #1003 459 415 (Home Depot-hosted PDF); English pages 1 and 2 read in full with the research tool's pdf command, Spanish pages repeat the same battery line.
Cell details are on page 1 (package contents, part B) and page 2 (replacing the battery); the solar panel and charging description are on page 1 (How solar works).
Home Depot product and Q&A pages for 84066 returned HTTP 403 or were not opened.
A search for a teardown or driver chip for 84066 found none.

comps.spec: Solar panel in the light that charges the rechargeable cell from sunlight during the day
One AA NiMH rechargeable cell, 1.2 V, 1000 mAh, pre-installed; the manual asks for a replacement of 1000 mAh or greater
comps.loc: Behind the battery cover (C), under the top cover (A)

comps.spec: LED light source (the guide is titled Solar LED Path Light)

sources.title: Hampton Bay Solar LED Path Light Use and Care Guide, Model #84066, Item #1003 459 415 (Home Depot-hosted PDF, English and Spanish)
